Critical Presents: Binary Vol.30

Japanese/Australian producer Fonts becomes the latest intern on Critical Music’s new artist platform, Binary, with a four-track EP of drum & bass from the soulful side.

From the dreamy, silky-smooth liquid rollers of ‘Patience’ and ‘Crystals’ to the grizzled, prodding funk of ‘Answers’ and the moody jungle jazz of ‘Slowdance’, FONTS showcases a distinct signature style that’s alive with groove and meticulous attention to detail.
